templates.name: Implement, test and review loop
templates.description: An agent implements the task, failing tests go back for fixes (up to 3), a reviewer approves, and a pull request opens.
templates.author: Volt

templates.name: Fix failing CI
templates.description: When a GitHub Actions run fails, an agent fixes it on the same branch, tests it locally and pushes the fix.
templates.author: Volt

templates.name: Review a pull request
templates.description: Every new pull request gets a review comment from a read-only agent; approved ones get a label.
templates.author: Volt

templates.name: Nightly dependency update
templates.description: Every night, dependencies are upgraded on a branch, tested, and opened as a draft pull request.
templates.author: Volt

templates.name: Triage Sentry issue
templates.description: New Sentry issues are sorted; regressions get a root-cause analysis posted to Slack.
templates.author: Volt

templates.name: Release notes on tag
templates.description: A pushed version tag gets release notes written from its commits and published as a GitHub release.
templates.author: Volt

templates.name: Uptime check every 5 minutes
templates.description: Requests a URL every five minutes and tells Slack when it is down or slow.
templates.author: Volt

templates.name: Issue to draft PR
templates.description: Label an issue "volt" and an agent implements it, tests it and opens a draft pull request.
templates.author: Volt

templates.name: Daily Slack digest
templates.description: Every weekday morning, the last day's commits are summarized and posted to Slack.
templates.author: Volt

templates.name: Parallel research with fork/join
templates.description: Three agents research a question from different angles at once; a join merges their findings into a report.
templates.author: Volt

templates.name: Label pull requests by size
templates.description: New pull requests get a size/S, size/M or size/L label from their diff size. No agent, no model cost.
templates.author: Volt

templates.name: Docs follow-up on merge
templates.description: After a merge, an agent updates the documentation the change made wrong and opens a draft pull request.
templates.author: Volt

templates.name: Incident first look
templates.description: When PagerDuty pages, an agent sums up the likely cause from recent changes; you approve it before it goes to Slack.
templates.author: Volt

templates.name: Weekly TODO sweep
templates.description: Every Monday, the TODO and FIXME comments worth doing this week go to a Microsoft Teams channel.
templates.author: Volt
